products.name: VORTEX 01 OVERSIZED TEE
products.description: Ultra-heavyweight 280 GSM combed jersey with custom boxy architectural silhouette. Screen-printed ZIPROO typographic monogram at chest, silicone wash for silky hand-feel, and reinforced double-needle neck ribbing.
products.fabricDetails: 100% Organic Combed Heavy Cotton · 280 GSM · Pre-shrunk Boxy Fit
products.careInstructions: Cold machine wash inside out. Do not bleach. Dry flat in shade. Iron on reverse.

reviews.comment: The 280 GSM cotton is phenomenal. Drops cleanly on the shoulders without wrinkling. The purple monogram is subtle and high-grade.
Best oversized tee in India hands down. Fits boxy, heavyweight collar ribbing does not sag after wash.

products.name: SHADOW MONOLITH HEAVY HOODIE
products.description: The definitive ZIPROO outerwear statement. Crafted from 480 GSM diagonal french terry with deep double-layered storm hood, custom matte gunmetal hardware, and concealed side-seam stash pockets.
products.fabricDetails: 100% French Terry Cotton · 480 GSM · Dropped Shoulder Box Cut
products.careInstructions: Cold gentle cycle inside out. Do not tumble dry. Lay flat to dry. Cool iron if necessary.

reviews.comment: 480 GSM French Terry feels like luxury armor. Hood holds its shape perfectly. Worth every rupee.

products.name: CYBER-TACTICAL CARGO PANTS
products.description: Engineered utility trousers featuring 6 waterproof zippered gusset pockets, articulated knee darts for unrestricted motion, and adjustable toggle ankles for convertible wide-leg or tapered styling.
products.fabricDetails: High-density Matte Ripstop Nylon Blend · Teflon DWR Coated · Water Repellent
products.careInstructions: Cold machine wash with mild detergent. Fasten all zippers before washing. Do not use fabric softener. Air dry.

reviews.comment: Tactical cargo perfection. Waterproof zippers and knee articulation make it effortless to style with chunky kicks.

products.name: NIGHTFALL MODULAR OVERSHIRT
products.description: Architectural short-sleeve workwear overshirt with laser-cut ventilation eyelets, matte industrial snap closures, and structural chest flap pockets. Perfect as an outer layer over our oversized tees.
products.fabricDetails: Structured Cotton-Twill Blend · 240 GSM · Industrial Matte Snaps
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold delicate. Do not wring. Hang dry. Medium iron if needed.

products.name: IDENTITY MATRIX ACID TEE
products.description: Hand-distressed mineral acid wash tee featuring subtle iridescent purple foil accents. Each garment undergoes a bespoke washing treatment rendering no two pieces identical.
products.fabricDetails: 100% Ring-Spun Cotton · 220 GSM · Mineral Acid Washed
products.careInstructions: Gentle wash cold inside out. Do not tumble dry. Do not iron directly on print.

products.name: ECLIPSE BOX CUT OVERSIZED TEE
products.description: Exaggerated dropped shoulders with a cropped architectural hemline. Screen-printed with the ZIPROO manifesto "DON'T FOLLOW THE RULES. CREATE IT." across the upper back shoulders.
products.fabricDetails: Premium Heavy Cotton Jersey · 290 GSM · Custom Boxy Fit
products.careInstructions: Cold gentle wash. Wash inside out. Dry in shade. Do not iron directly on print.

products.name: ARCHITECT HYBRID UTILITY PANTS
products.description: Tailored urban trousers with integrated webbing magnetic buckle belt, dual side cargo bellows, and purple contrast bartack stitching at all high-stress tension points.
products.fabricDetails: Technical Stretch Twill · 98% Cotton 2% Spandex · Magnetic Webbing Belt
products.careInstructions: Cold machine wash with similar colors. Remove or secure belt buckle before washing.

products.name: NEO-VIOLET ZIP HOODIE
products.description: Full-zip luxury streetwear hoodie with two-way heavy YKK zipper, internal purple piping, and embroidered ZIPROO tonal insignia along the left cuff.
products.fabricDetails: 460 GSM Heavy French Terry Cotton · YKK 2-Way Zipper · Tonal Embroidery

updates.title: ZIPROO 2026 Debut Drop Officially Announced
updates.content: Today marks the official reveal of ZIPROO Capsule 01. Founded with an uncompromising vision: Don't follow the rules. Create it. Our flagship 480 GSM hoodies and engineered utilitarian cargo pants are now accessible across India and globally.
updates.author: Rohith Sharma (Founder)

updates.title: Behind the Atelier: Sourcing 480 GSM French Terry
updates.content: After six months of meticulous prototyping across specialized textile mills, we selected an unbrushed diagonal cotton terry. It holds the structural silhouette of our hoodies without slouching, yet delivers cloud-soft interior comfort.
updates.author: Ranjith Kumar (Co-founder)

updates.title: Identity Series 01 Prototype Fitting & Runway Preview
updates.content: Completed sample fittings for our upcoming Nightfall Modular Overshirt and Architect Utility Pants in our central design studio. Tension testing on the magnetic Fidlock buckles passed with zero defect tolerance.
updates.author: Ranjith Kumar (Co-founder)

updates.title: All-India Express Logistics Network Activated
updates.content: To honor our commitment to premium streetwear enthusiasts, we have secured express courier lanes with end-to-end SMS tracking and guaranteed dispatch within 24 hours.
updates.author: Ranjith Kumar (Co-founder)
